scope: Authored deterministic local fixtures, no provider requests, real students, diagnoses, calibrated mastery or proven learning improvement

checks.name: Shuffling answer positions preserves canonical identity and answer value
Copied shuffled first-choice records cannot inflate distinct-question count
Answer-letter explanations cannot split the identity of an ordinary MCQ
Different correct answer, prompt or options changes question identity
Whitespace and NFC equivalents deduplicate without algebraic equivalence claims
Positional dependencies retain ordered identity rather than unsafe shuffling
Old q1 evidence stays readable and observed history is untouched but inference is excluded
A known legacy MCQ remains previously seen even after its choices rotate
Malformed optional prior snapshots cannot crash canonical exposure detection
Excluding an attempt changes inference only and restoration recovers the same observations
Exclusions operate across copied attempt IDs and never affect another library
Exclusion and focus controls are bounded, cloned, and backward-compatible
Actually overdue cards precede unseen cards regardless of array order
Postponing a review creates no event, adaptive review, score or mastery data
Manual future scheduling also supports unseen cards without fabricating first review
Restoring the adaptive schedule brings a truly overdue card back
Edited or deleted cards invalidate manual schedules safely
Manual schedules reject past, malformed and overlong dates without changing state
Override parser rejects duplicate keys, wrong identities and malformed timestamps
Old learning data remain readable and optional overrides round trip
Recommendation due counts honor the same manual deferral as review queue
Empty library creates no invented plan or resource
Daily plan has one primary and at most two distinct-material alternatives
Overdue cards become a factual primary action with observed count
Learner focus overrides order explicitly without overwriting skill results
Opt-out prevents inferred profile and ignores stored focus preference
Unknown subjects never produce diagnosed skill or invented prerequisite actions
Excluded weak-topic evidence stops driving inferred practice while its recorded score remains
Sync retains overrides, exclusions and focus without changing observed scores
Concurrent manual schedule edits conflict rather than silently overwriting
Old 7244-style normalization cannot delete unsupported V8 controls during merge
Explicit [] and focus null clear V8 controls rather than preserving them
Excluding prior evidence never turns a retry into new independent evidence
All five locales expose usable plan, privacy and scheduling controls
